kind.description: narration: scene and description; dialogue: one character's spoken lines; action: what one character does.

speaker.description: Who speaks or acts, by the name used in the character profiles. Required for dialogue. Names only, never IDs.

text.description: Complete prose for this segment, with no blank line inside. Start a new segment when the speaker changes.

segments.description: The story of this reply, in reading order.

cues.description: Stage cues for this reply: the scene, who is present, the mood.

scene.description: Where the scene takes place, in a few words.

present.description: The characters present in the scene, by name. Names only, never IDs.

mood.description: The mood of the scene, in a few words.

yield.description: Who acts next. Leave it out unless asked; defaults to user.
